character_tex: The $\mathcal{N}=1$ characters $\chi^{NS}_{r,s} = q^{-c/24}\prod_{n\ge1}\frac{1+q^{n-1/2}}{1-q^n}\sum_{k}\left(q^{a_k}-q^{b_k}\right)$ and $\chi^{R}_{r,s} = q^{1/16-c/24}\prod_{n\ge1}\frac{1+q^{n}}{1-q^n}\sum_{k}\left(q^{a_k}-q^{b_k}\right)$, $a_k = \frac{(2pp'k+p'r-ps)^2-4}{8pp'}$, $b_k = \frac{(2pp'k+p'r+ps)^2-4}{8pp'}$, $(p,p') = (30,32)$. With $r = l+1$, $s = l'+1$: $b^{(l,0,l')}$ and $b^{(l,2,l')}$ are the parts of $\chi^{NS}_{r,s}$ at integer and half-integer level (whichever matches the coset weight), and $b^{(l,1,l')} = \chi^R_{r,s}$.
description: Coset $SU(2)_{28}\times SU(2)_2/SU(2)_{30}$ with the (E_8,A) invariant (E_8 on the level-28 label, A on the level-30 label). Blocks are the coset branching functions $b^{(l,\epsilon,l')}$ with $(l,\epsilon,l')\sim(28-l,2-\epsilon,30-l')$.
